# Yunqi

> Yunqi is a high-performance multi-upstream AI API proxy and protocol translation gateway supporting Claude, OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Images, Codex Responses, and Gemini.

Yunqi provides unified proxy entry, built-in web admin, channel orchestration, failover, multi-key management, and model routing. Built with Go 1.25 + Gin backend and Vue 3 frontend.

## Getting Started

- [Quick Start](https://soulteary.github.io/yunqi/en/guide/getting-started): Install, configure, and run Yunqi for the first time
- [Web console and migration](https://soulteary.github.io/yunqi/en/guide/desktop/): Browser console, client setup and migration from older desktop installations
- [Deployment](https://soulteary.github.io/yunqi/en/guide/deployment): Production deployment guide
- [Environment Variables](https://soulteary.github.io/yunqi/en/guide/environment): All environment variables and defaults

## Client Setup

- [Client Overview](https://soulteary.github.io/yunqi/en/guide/clients/): Supported clients and integration overview
- [Claude Code](https://soulteary.github.io/yunqi/en/guide/clients/claude-code): Configure Claude Code to use Yunqi as proxy
- [Codex CLI / Codex App](https://soulteary.github.io/yunqi/en/guide/clients/codex): Configure Codex to use Yunqi
- [OpenCode](https://soulteary.github.io/yunqi/en/guide/clients/opencode): Configure OpenCode to use Yunqi
